title: Accio Sourcing Expert is now free for European SMEs: what the new Startup Pack gives your business
lede: Alibaba.com announced the European SME Startup Pack at CoCreate Europe in London. Product research, supplier checks and profit calculation run in Auto Mode at no cost. Here are the numbers, the limits and a prompt to start tonight.
dateLabel: Published 22 November 2026 - based on the Alibaba.com announcement of 19 November
intro: On 19 November 2026, at the opening of its two-day CoCreate Europe summit at ExCeL London, Alibaba.com launched the European SME Startup Pack. Its core is free access to Accio Sourcing Expert in Auto Mode for small and medium-sized businesses across Europe.

The pack bundles sourcing and design tools and automates the slow parts of buying: product research, supplier vetting and profit analysis. Alibaba.com presents it as a way for small teams to do more with less in 2027.

packTitle: What you can do for free
packIntro: In Auto Mode, Sourcing Expert covers the whole research part of a purchase. You describe what you need, the agent does the legwork and returns tables you can act on.

pack.title: Find products
pack.body: Describe the product, target price and market. The agent searches suppliers and returns candidates with prices, MOQ and lead times.

pack.title: Compare options
pack.body: Select up to 5 product or supplier cards and get a conclusion plus an Excel comparison table that updates as you add more.

pack.title: Verify suppliers
pack.body: Check years in business, certifications, trade history and risk signals before you send money. Reports now include category benchmarks.

pack.title: Calculate profit
pack.body: Estimate your margin from the supplier price, shipping and your selling price before you commit to an order.

benchTitle: Why it costs less: the benchmark
benchText: Alibaba.com ran its Commerce Agent Bench: 107 standardised e-commerce tasks. Running cost for the whole set:
benchNote: This is Alibaba.com's own test, not an independent study. Alibaba.com says Accio matched the task quality of the other agents at about half the cost.
who: Small and medium-sized businesses in Europe: the pack was announced for the European market at CoCreate Europe.
Everyone else: since version 0.36.2 (25 October 2026), Sourcing Agent tasks in Auto Mode are already free within Accio's quota worldwide, except AI-assisted supplier chat.
Alibaba.com has not said how long the European offer runs or exactly which countries it covers, so check the conditions in your account.
ctaTitle: Delegate your first sourcing task for free tonight
ctaText: Sign up for Accio Work, open Sourcing Expert, keep Auto Mode on and paste the prompt below. You will have a shortlist of suppliers by morning.

steps.title: Create an Accio Work account
steps.body: Sign up on the web or install the desktop app. The web version is always up to date.

steps.title: Open Sourcing Expert and keep Auto
steps.body: Choose Sourcing Expert and leave the model on Auto. That is the mode covered by the free offer.

steps.title: Give it a concrete task
steps.body: Name the product, quantity, target price and destination country. Use the prompt below as a starting point.

prompt: Find 5 verified suppliers for [product] with MOQ under [quantity] units and a unit price under [price] EUR. For each, show years in business, certifications, MOQ, lead time and a risk note. Compare them in a table and calculate my margin if I sell at [selling price] EUR in [country], including estimated shipping.
limits: Free access applies to Auto Mode. AI-assisted chat and negotiation with suppliers uses credits.
The duration and exact country list of the European offer have not been published.
1688 products in sourcing are still not available in Europe and the Americas.
The benchmark figures come from Alibaba.com. Test the agent on your own task before relying on it.

faq.q: What is the European SME Startup Pack?
faq.a: A package from Alibaba.com, launched on 19 November 2026, that gives European small and medium-sized businesses free access to Accio Sourcing Expert in Auto Mode, together with sourcing and design tools.

faq.q: Is Accio Sourcing Expert really free?
faq.a: Yes, in Auto Mode: product search, comparison, supplier verification and profit calculation. AI-assisted supplier chat uses credits.

faq.q: How much cheaper is Accio than other AI agents?
faq.a: In Alibaba.com's 107-task benchmark, Accio cost $3.69, versus $9.27 for OpenAI Codex and $9.51 for Anthropic Claude Code, so roughly half or less. This is the vendor's own test.

faq.q: Can I use it outside Europe?
faq.a: Yes. Since version 0.36.2, Sourcing Agent tasks in Auto Mode are free within Accio's quota for all users, except AI-assisted supplier chat.
